host_plugin.name: Advanced Custom Fields (field groups, post types, taxonomies, options and field values)

operations.name: list-field-groups
operations.description: List registered ACF field groups: key, title, a flattened summary of their location rules, and whether each is active

operations.name: get-fields
operations.description: Read a post's ACF field values, keyed by field name, via get_fields()

operations.name: update-fields
operations.description: Set one or more ACF field values on a post via update_field(). Snapshotted on the post target; restorable with rollback-operation. Disabled by default (site opts in via the wpmcp_enable_acf_write filter)

operations.name: get-field-group
operations.description: Read one field group by key with every setting and its full field tree

operations.name: list-field-types
operations.description: List the field types this ACF install offers (name, label, category)

operations.name: list-post-types
operations.description: List ACF-registered post types: key, title, post_type slug, active, local

operations.name: get-post-type
operations.description: Read one ACF post type by key with every setting

operations.name: list-taxonomies
operations.description: List ACF-registered taxonomies: key, title, taxonomy slug, active, local

operations.name: get-taxonomy
operations.description: Read one ACF taxonomy by key with every setting

operations.name: validate-fields
operations.description: Check values against their fields with ACF's own validation (required, number range, email, URL, custom rules) without writing. Pass post_id so field names resolve by that post's groups

operations.name: get-options
operations.description: List options pages, or read one page's field values when page (its menu slug) is given. Needs ACF Pro

operations.name: update-options
operations.description: Set field values on an options page via update_field(). Snapshotted; rollback-operation restores the prior rows exactly. Needs ACF Pro. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_acf_write filter)

operations.name: save-field-group
operations.description: Create or update a field group. fields (optional) replaces the field list: keep a field by passing its key, omit it to delete it; each needs label, name and a type from list-field-types, and may nest sub_fields. Upsert by key (omit key to create). Snapshotted; rollback-operation restores it exactly. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_acf_write filter)

operations.name: save-post-type
operations.description: Create or update an ACF post type (registered by ACF on the next request). New ones need post_type (slug, max 20) and title (plural label); other ACF settings pass through. Upsert by key (omit key to create). Snapshotted; rollback-operation restores it exactly. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_acf_write filter)

operations.name: save-taxonomy
operations.description: Create or update an ACF taxonomy (registered by ACF on the next request). New ones need taxonomy (slug, max 32) and title (plural label); object_type lists post types. Upsert by key (omit key to create). Snapshotted; rollback-operation restores it exactly. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_acf_write filter)

operations.name: list-forms
operations.description: List Contact Form 7 forms with id, title, and slug

operations.name: get-form
operations.description: Read one form: title, slug, the form markup, and the mail template

operations.name: list-fields
operations.description: List one form's fields as Contact Form 7 parses them out of the form markup: name, type, whether it is required, and its options

operations.name: list-notifications
operations.description: List a form's mail notifications: the primary Mail template and the optional Mail (2) autoresponder, each with whether it is active, recipient, sender, subject, and body template

operations.name: list-entries
operations.description: List a form's Flamingo-stored submissions, newest first (sender name, sender email and subject are MASKED; get-entry returns one in full), with paging (page_size default 20, max 100, plus offset) and a status filter (inbox, the default, plus spam and trash, which Flamingo keeps out of the default listing). form_id is required and is resolved to the form's Flamingo channel term; a form whose channel binding is missing is refused rather than answered with an unscoped listing. Requires the Flamingo plugin and the edit_users capability because submissions are user data

operations.name: get-entry
operations.description: Read one Flamingo-stored submission in full: subject, sender, channel, submitted fields, and meta. Requires the Flamingo plugin and the edit_users capability (the cap Flamingo itself gates inbound messages behind) because submissions are user data

operations.name: update-entry-status
operations.description: Move one Flamingo-stored submission between the inbox and the trash, through Flamingo's own trash()/untrash() so it lands where Flamingo's screen expects it. Snapshotted first and restorable with rollback-operation. Spam flagging is deliberately not offered: Flamingo reports spam to Akismet, which would send the submission to a third-party service. Requires the Flamingo plugin and the edit_users capability

operations.name: delete-entry
operations.description: Delete one Flamingo-stored submission. Default-off (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write), requires confirm:true, the Flamingo plugin, and the edit_users capability. Reversible: a Flamingo entry is a flamingo_inbound post, so it is snapshotted (row, postmeta, channel terms) before deletion and can be resurrected at its original id with rollback-operation using the returned operation_id. Deletion is therefore NOT erasure: the snapshot keeps a verbatim plaintext copy of the submission (name, email, remote IP, message body) until Snapshot_Store prunes it. Restoring it is held to the same edit_users bar as deleting it (rollback-operation is otherwise an edit_posts ability), but the plaintext copy still exists, so use a real erasure tool if the goal is to destroy the data

operations.name: list-messages
operations.description: List a form's system messages (mail_sent_ok, validation_error and the rest) with the key of each, which update-messages takes

operations.name: update-notification
operations.description: Edit one mail template of a form (mail or mail_2): enabled (mail_2 only), subject, body, sender and reply_to. Recipients are changed with set-notification-recipients. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write). Returns before and after of every changed field. Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: set-notification-recipients
operations.description: Change who a mail template is sent to: to (the recipient), cc and bcc (kept in the template's additional headers; an empty string removes one). This redirects personal data, so it needs confirm:true, and the confirmation shows the recipients before and after. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write). Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: update-messages
operations.description: Set some of a form's system messages (mail_sent_ok, validation_error and the rest; keys from list-messages). Values are plain text up to 400 characters. Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write). Returns before and after. Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: list-forms
operations.description: List Forminator forms with id, display name, status, and the shortcode that embeds each form

operations.name: get-form
operations.description: Read one Forminator form: display name, embed shortcode, and its fields (id, type, label, required)

operations.name: list-entries
operations.description: List a Forminator form's submissions with paging (page_size default 20, max 100) and their decoded field values MASKED (get-entry returns one in full)

operations.name: get-entry
operations.description: Read one Forminator submission by form_id plus entry_id, with its decoded field values

operations.name: delete-entry
operations.description: Permanently delete one Forminator submission (refused with entry_has_payments when it has a Stripe or PayPal record) with its values (the rows of the frmt_form_entry and frmt_form_entry_meta tables, removed directly: Forminator's own delete hooks do not run and uploaded files stay on disk). Off by default (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write); needs confirm:true. Reversible: every row is snapshotted first and rollback-session puts them back. Deletion is NOT erasure: the snapshot keeps a verbatim copy of the submission until Snapshot_Store prunes it.

operations.name: list-forms
operations.description: List GiveWP donation forms with id, title, status, and running earnings and sales counts

operations.name: get-form
operations.description: Read one donation form: title, status, and its curated configuration (price, price option, donation levels, goal option and amount, earnings, sales)

operations.name: list-donations
operations.description: List GiveWP donations, newest first: id, status, date, amount, currency, form, campaign, donor id, gateway, mode; donor name and email MASKED. Filter by status, form_id, donor_id, campaign_id, mode (live or test), from and to (YYYY-MM-DD)

operations.name: get-donation
operations.description: Read one GiveWP donation in full: amount, status, form, campaign, donor name, email, phone, company, billing address, comment, anonymous flag, gateway, transaction id and mode

operations.name: list-donors
operations.description: List GiveWP donors, newest first: id, user id, total donated, donation count, created date; name and email MASKED. search matches name or email

operations.name: get-donor
operations.description: Read one GiveWP donor in full: name, email, additional emails, first and last name, company, totals and the 10 latest donations

operations.name: list-campaigns
operations.description: List GiveWP campaigns (GiveWP 4+): title, status, goal and goal type, dates, page, default form and every form, and raised amount and count from completed live donations. Filter by status

operations.name: donation-summary
operations.description: Count and total GiveWP donations by status and currency (trash left out). Filter by form_id, campaign_id, mode (live or test), from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, site time)

operations.name: update-form
operations.description: Change a GiveWP donation form: title, status (publish, draft, pending, private), price (the set amount, single-amount forms only), goal_enabled, goal. Visual form builder forms take status only. Snapshotted; undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: update-donation-status
operations.description: Change a GiveWP donation's status (complete, pending, processing, refunded, failed, cancelled, abandoned, revoked, preapproval) through GiveWP, which recalculates totals and may email the donor; no gateway refund is made. Needs confirm:true; the record is snapshotted but the emails and totals are not undoable

host_plugin.name: Gravity Tables (data tables built from Gravity Forms entries)

operations.name: list-tables
operations.description: List published Gravity Tables with id, title, linked form id, and shortcode

operations.name: get-table
operations.description: Read one table's full configuration, including the decoded settings (selected fields, labels, sortable/filterable columns)

host_plugin.name: Modern Events Calendar (events and their schedules)

operations.name: list-events
operations.description: List Modern Events Calendar events with id, title, status, and start/end date, newest first (paged; page_size default 20, max 100)

operations.name: get-event
operations.description: Read one event: title, content, status, and its curated MEC schedule (start/end date and time, all-day flag, location and organizer ids, cost), category ids, read more URL, whether it repeats, and its MEC event status (canceled, postponed) with reason

operations.name: list-locations
operations.description: List Modern Events Calendar locations (id, name, slug, event count, address, latitude, longitude, URL); paged, optional search

operations.name: list-organizers
operations.description: List Modern Events Calendar organizers (id, name, slug, event count, URL; phone and email masked); paged, optional search

operations.name: list-categories
operations.description: List Modern Events Calendar categories (id, name, slug, parent, event count); paged, optional search

operations.name: create-event
operations.description: Create a one-time Modern Events Calendar event (dates, times or all-day, location, organizer, categories, cost, read more URL). Saved as a draft unless status is given. Recorded as a creation: rollback-operation trashes it

operations.name: update-event
operations.description: Change a Modern Events Calendar event: any of title, content, excerpt, status, dates and times (one-time events only), location, organizer, categories, cost, URL; omitted fields are kept. Snapshotted and reversible

operations.name: cancel-event
operations.description: Mark a Modern Events Calendar event canceled (MEC event status) with an optional reason shown on the event; the event stays listed. Snapshotted and reversible

operations.name: create-location
operations.description: Create a Modern Events Calendar location (name, address, latitude, longitude, URL). Snapshotted: rollback-operation deletes it

operations.name: create-organizer
operations.description: Create a Modern Events Calendar organizer (name, phone, email, URL). Snapshotted: rollback-operation deletes it

host_plugin.name: Meta Box (registered meta boxes and per-post custom field values)

operations.name: list-meta-boxes
operations.description: List registered Meta Box meta boxes: id, title, post types, and their field ids/types

operations.name: get-fields
operations.description: Read a post's Meta Box field values for the given field keys, via rwmb_meta()

operations.name: update-fields
operations.description: Set one or more Meta Box field values on a post via rwmb_set_meta(). Snapshotted on the post target; restorable with rollback-operation. Disabled by default (site opts in via the wpmcp_enable_metabox_write filter)

operations.name: list-forms
operations.description: List MetForm forms with id, title, status, entry count, and the shortcode that embeds each form

operations.name: get-form
operations.description: Read one MetForm form: title, embed shortcode, and its fields (name, label, type, required) parsed from the form's Elementor layout

operations.name: list-entries
operations.description: List a MetForm form's entries, newest first, with paging (page_size default 20, max 100) and their stored field values MASKED (get-entry returns one in full)

operations.name: get-entry
operations.description: Read one MetForm entry by entry_id, with its source form, timestamp, and stored field values

operations.name: delete-entry
operations.description: Delete one MetForm entry. Default-off (opt in with wpmcp_enable_forms_write); requires confirm:true. Reversible: a MetForm entry is a metform-entry post, so it is snapshotted (row plus postmeta) before deletion and can be resurrected at its original id with rollback-operation using the returned operation_id

host_plugin.name: JetEngine and Pods fields, TranslatePress strings, Code Snippets, BuddyPress and BuddyBoss Platform community data, bbPress forums, WS Form and Everest Forms forms, WP Activity Log and Simple History logs, Pretty Links and ThirstyAffiliates links, Advanced Ads ads and placements, Popup Maker popups, OptinMonster campaigns, Events Manager events and bookings, Action Scheduler queues, Site Reviews reviews, WP Mail Logging, Check and Log Email and Email Log emails, WPGraphQL queries, WP Simple Pay forms, Paid Member Subscriptions plans, wpForo and Asgaros Forum forums, Restrict Content and Restrict Content Pro memberships, Ultimate Member roles and forms, Easy Digital Downloads stores, WP Job Manager, GeoDirectory and Directorist listings, PublishPress Planner, PublishPress Checklists and PublishPress Future, FooGallery galleries

emaillog-get-email.name: WP Mail Logging, Check and Log Email, Email Log

emaillog-list-emails.name: WP Mail Logging, Check and Log Email, Email Log

operations.name: bbpress-list-forums
operations.description: List bbPress forums (id, title, status, parent forum, forum or category, topic and reply counts, last activity); parent_id lists one forum's subforums

operations.name: bbpress-list-topics
operations.description: List the topics of a bbPress forum, newest first (id, title, status publish/closed/spam/pending, sticky, author, reply and voice counts, last activity, tags); filter by status or tag slug

operations.name: bbpress-get-topic
operations.description: Read one bbPress topic (title, content, status, forum, counts, tags) with its replies in posting order, paged

operations.name: bbpress-create-topic
operations.description: Post a topic in a bbPress forum (title, content, status publish or pending) through bbPress, as you. Snapshotted; rollback-operation deletes it and puts the forum counts back

operations.name: bbpress-create-reply
operations.description: Post a reply to a bbPress topic (content, optional reply_to: a reply in the same topic) through bbPress, as you. Snapshotted; rollback-operation deletes it and puts the counts back

operations.name: bbpress-moderate-topic
operations.description: Moderate a bbPress topic through bbPress: close (no new replies), stick (to the top of its forum) or spam (hides it and its replies). Needs bbPress's moderate capability. Snapshotted and reversible

operations.name: jetengine-list-fields
operations.description: List the JetEngine fields registered for a post type (name, title, type)

operations.name: jetengine-get-fields
operations.description: Read a post's JetEngine field values (every field of its post type, or the given keys)

operations.name: jetengine-update-fields
operations.description: Set JetEngine field values on a post (keys must be fields of its post type). Snapshotted on the post; restorable with rollback-operation. Off until the site opts in via the wpmcp_enable_jetengine_write filter

operations.name: pods-list-fields
operations.description: List the Pods fields of a post type pod (name, label, type, writable) and its storage (meta or table)

operations.name: pods-get-fields
operations.description: Read a post's Pods field values (every field of its pod, or the given keys) from meta or the pod table

operations.name: pods-update-fields
operations.description: Set simple Pods field values (text, number, date, boolean and the like) on a post, in meta or the pod table. Snapshotted; restorable with rollback-operation. Off until the site opts in via the wpmcp_enable_pods_write filter

operations.name: translatepress-list-languages
operations.description: List TranslatePress's default language and translation languages

operations.name: translatepress-get-strings
operations.description: Page through a language's TranslatePress strings (id, original, translated, status 0 none, 1 machine, 2 reviewed), optionally filtered by a search on the original and by status

operations.name: translatepress-update-strings
operations.description: Set translations of existing TranslatePress strings by id in one language (an empty translation clears it). Snapshotted; restorable with rollback-operation

operations.name: code-snippets-list-snippets
operations.description: List Code Snippets snippets (id, name, type, scope, status, tags, priority; no code); filter by scope, status or tag

operations.name: code-snippets-get-snippet
operations.description: Read one Code Snippets snippet with its code and, for PHP, a static check report (advisory)

operations.name: code-snippets-create-snippet
operations.description: Create a PHP snippet in Code Snippets, always inactive; code failing the static check is refused. Snapshotted; rollback deletes it

operations.name: code-snippets-update-snippet
operations.description: Change an inactive snippet's name, description, tags or priority (any type) or a PHP snippet's code; new code must pass the static check. Active snippets are refused (deactivate first). Snapshotted

operations.name: code-snippets-deactivate-snippet
operations.description: Deactivate a Code Snippets snippet (never gated, so a snippet can always be switched off). Snapshotted

operations.name: code-snippets-trash-snippet
operations.description: Move an inactive, unlocked Code Snippets snippet of any type to its trash. Active snippets are refused (deactivate first). Snapshotted; rollback brings it back

operations.name: wsform-list-forms
operations.description: List WS Form forms: id, label, status (draft, publish, trash), whether the editor has unpublished changes, shortcode, and submission counts (total, unread, spam, trash) counted live. status filters; trash is left out unless asked for

operations.name: wsform-get-form
operations.description: Read one WS Form form: label, status, shortcode, counts, and its tabs with their sections and fields (id, type, label)

operations.name: wsform-list-fields
operations.description: List one WS Form form's fields in form order: id, key (field_N, the key of its submitted value), type, label, required, tab and section, and the choices of checkbox, radio and select fields

operations.name: wsform-list-actions
operations.description: List one WS Form form's actions in run order (save to submissions, send email, show message, redirect, webhooks and others): row id, action type, label, active, the events it runs on, and its settings

operations.name: wsform-list-notifications
operations.description: List one WS Form form's email notifications (its "email" actions): row id, label, active, to, cc, bcc, from, reply-to, subject and message template

operations.name: wsform-list-entries
operations.description: List a WS Form form's submissions newest first: id, status, starred, viewed, dates and every field value MASKED (wsform-get-entry returns one in full). status: publish, draft (in progress), error, spam or trash; by default all but spam and trash, as WS Form lists them. page_size (default 20, max 100) and offset. Personal data

operations.name: wsform-get-entry
operations.description: One WS Form submission in full: status, starred, viewed, dates, user, every field value (key, label, type, value), tracking data such as the IP address, the actions log and the wp-admin notes. Personal data

operations.name: wsform-update-entry-status
operations.description: Set a WS Form submission's status (publish, draft, spam or trash), starred and/or viewed. Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: wsform-delete-entry
operations.description: Permanently delete a WS Form submission with its values and notes (set status trash instead to keep it in WS Form). Uploaded files stay on disk. Needs confirm:true. Undo: rollback-session reinserts every row

operations.name: everestforms-list-forms
operations.description: List Everest Forms forms: id, title, status, shortcode, and entry counts (total, unread, spam, trash). status filters (publish, draft, trash); trash is left out unless asked for

operations.name: everestforms-get-form
operations.description: Read one Everest Forms form: title, status, shortcode, entry counts, its fields in form order, and its main settings (success message, redirect, submit button text, whether entries are stored)

operations.name: everestforms-list-fields
operations.description: List one Everest Forms form's fields in form order: id, key (the meta key its value is stored under), type, label, required, and the choices of checkbox, radio and select fields

operations.name: everestforms-list-notifications
operations.description: List one Everest Forms form's email notifications: connection id, name, active, to, from name and email, reply-to, subject and message template

operations.name: everestforms-list-entries
operations.description: List an Everest Forms form's entries newest first: id, status, starred, viewed, date and every field value MASKED (everestforms-get-entry returns one in full). status: publish, spam, trash, draft, pending, approved or denied; by default all but spam, trash and draft. page_size (default 20, max 100) and offset. Personal data

operations.name: everestforms-get-entry
operations.description: One Everest Forms entry in full: status, starred, viewed, date, user, every field value (id, key, label, type, value), IP address, user agent and referer. Does not mark it read. Personal data

operations.name: everestforms-update-entry-status
operations.description: Mark an Everest Forms entry spam or not spam (status spam or publish), starred and/or read (viewed). Entries in trash, draft or approval keep their status. Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: everestforms-delete-entry
operations.description: Permanently delete an Everest Forms entry with its stored values. Uploaded files stay on disk. Needs confirm:true. Undo: rollback-session reinserts every row

operations.name: activitylog-list-activity
operations.description: List WP Activity Log or Simple History events newest first: id, time (UTC), user, severity, event, object, message, IP. Filters: user_id, username, object_id (post id), event (WP Activity Log alert id, Simple History logger), since and until (dates), page_size (default 20, max 100), offset. source when both plugins are active. IPs, usernames and emails MASKED, activitylog-get-activity returns one in full. Personal data

operations.name: activitylog-get-activity
operations.description: One WP Activity Log or Simple History event in full: user, roles, severity, event, object, message, IP address, user agent and every metadata or context value. source when both plugins are active. Personal data

operations.name: actionscheduler-list-actions
operations.description: List Action Scheduler queue actions (WooCommerce and many plugins use it): id, hook, status, group, schedule, scheduled time (UTC; for a finished action the last attempt) and args with emails, IPs and tokens MASKED. Filters: hook, group, status (pending, complete, failed, canceled, running), date with date_compare (< <= > >= =, default <=); order asc or desc by date (default desc); page (max 1000) and per_page (default 20, max 100); args over 2 KB are cut to a preview (args_truncated), get-action returns them whole; total is an exact count. Masks emails and IPv4 only. Personal data

operations.name: actionscheduler-get-action
operations.description: One Action Scheduler action in full: hook, status, group, priority, schedule, scheduled time (UTC), args (tokens, keys and passwords hidden) and its log entries (the newest 100, oldest first), which say why a run failed. Personal data

operations.name: actionscheduler-cancel-action
operations.description: Cancel one pending Action Scheduler action so it never runs. Refuses an action that is not pending and WP MCP's own hooks. Off unless wpmcp_enable_action_scheduler_write. Undo: rollback-operation queues it again, pending, on its old schedule (the canceled record keeps its id)

operations.name: actionscheduler-run-action
operations.description: Run one pending Action Scheduler action now through the queue runner, whatever its schedule. Its hook's callbacks execute (mail, API calls, syncs) and that CANNOT be undone: recoverable:false, and it needs confirm:true after a preview. Refuses an action that is not pending and WP MCP's own hooks. Off unless wpmcp_enable_action_scheduler_write

operations.name: emaillog-list-emails
operations.description: List emails logged by WP Mail Logging, Check and Log Email or Email Log, newest first: id, time (site time), recipient, subject, status (sent or failed), error, has_attachments, source. Filters: recipient (matches the stored address, which is masked in the result), subject (substrings), status, since and until (dates, site time), page_size (default 20, max 100), offset. source when several plugins are active. Recipients MASKED (j***@example.com), no bodies or headers; emaillog-get-email returns one email. Personal data

operations.name: emaillog-get-email
operations.description: One logged email: recipients in full, subject, status, error, headers, attachment names. NO body unless body is truncated (1,000 characters) or full (20,000); a returned body is best-effort redacted (links with tokens, passwords, codes) and may still hold a secret. Credential headers blanked, IP never returned. source when several plugins are active. Personal data

operations.name: prettylinks-list-links
operations.description: List Pretty Links links newest first: id, slug, pretty URL, target url, name, redirect type, flags, click and unique counters, dates. status active (default), trashed or any; search over slug, name and url; redirect_type; page_size (default 20, max 100) and offset

operations.name: prettylinks-get-link
operations.description: Read one Pretty Links link with live click and unique-visitor counts

operations.name: prettylinks-get-link-clicks
operations.description: Recorded clicks of one Pretty Links link, newest first: time, host, referer, uri, browser, os, country, device, robot, first click, visitor IP MASKED. from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC), unique (first clicks only), page_size and offset. Totals counted live; Simple tracking mode records counters only, no rows

operations.name: prettylinks-create-link
operations.description: Create a Pretty Links link: url (http or https, required), slug (generated when empty), name, description, redirect_type (301, 302 or 307), nofollow, sponsored, track_me, new_window, param_forwarding. A slug another link holds, or with characters beyond letters, digits, - _ / ., is refused. Undo: rollback-operation removes it

operations.name: prettylinks-update-link
operations.description: Change a Pretty Links link; only the args given change (url, slug, name, description, redirect_type, flags). A slug another link holds is refused. Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: prettylinks-delete-link
operations.description: Move a Pretty Links link to its trash (deleted_at, as the plugin does; its redirect stops, clicks are kept). Not a permanent delete. Undo: rollback-operation brings it back

operations.name: thirstyaffiliates-list-links
operations.description: List ThirstyAffiliates links newest first: id, name, slug, cloaked URL, destination url, redirect type, toggles, categories, status, clicks. Filter by category (thirstylink-category id), status, search. page and per_page (max 100). Only links you may read

operations.name: thirstyaffiliates-get-link
operations.description: Read one ThirstyAffiliates link with its settings, categories and live click count

operations.name: thirstyaffiliates-get-link-clicks
operations.description: Recorded clicks of one ThirstyAffiliates link, newest first: time, referer, redirect url and type, keyword, browser, visitor IP MASKED. from and to (YYYY-MM-DD, UTC), page_size (max 100) and offset. Total counted live

operations.name: thirstyaffiliates-create-link
operations.description: Create a ThirstyAffiliates link: name and url (http or https) required; status defaults to publish; slug, redirect_type, toggles, categories (thirstylink-category ids). Undo: rollback-session trashes it

operations.name: thirstyaffiliates-update-link
operations.description: Change a ThirstyAffiliates link; only the args given change, and categories replace the link's set. Undo: rollback-operation

operations.name: thirstyaffiliates-delete-link
operations.description: Move a ThirstyAffiliates link to the WordPress trash (its redirect stops; clicks are kept). Not a permanent delete. Undo: rollback-operation brings it back

operations.name: advancedads-list-ads

timezone.description: A time zone name such as America/New_York, or UTC+5; defaults to the site time zone

operations.name: update-event
operations.description: Change a The Events Calendar event: any of title, content, excerpt, status, schedule (start/end, all-day, time zone), venue, organizers, categories, cost, URL; omitted fields are kept. Snapshotted and reversible

start_date.description: Local time YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM[:SS] in the event time zone; YYYY-MM-DD alone with all_day

end_date.description: Local time YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM[:SS] in the event time zone; YYYY-MM-DD alone with all_day

timezone.description: A time zone name such as America/New_York, or UTC+5; defaults to the site time zone

operations.name: cancel-event
operations.description: Mark a The Events Calendar event canceled (TEC event status) with an optional reason shown on the event; the event stays listed. Snapshotted and reversible

operations.name: create-venue
operations.description: Create a The Events Calendar venue (published unless status is given). Recorded as a creation: rollback-operation trashes it

operations.name: create-organizer
operations.description: Create a The Events Calendar organizer (published unless status is given). Recorded as a creation: rollback-operation trashes it

host_plugin.name: the active theme (context, mods), site identity, permalinks, Redirection, Rank Math redirects and 404 log, backup, security, analytics, cache, mail status, site gates, fonts

operations.name: get-theme-context
operations.description: Report the active theme context: stylesheet/template, parent theme, child-theme status, detected framework, block-theme support, probed theme_supports, and registered menu locations

operations.name: get-mods
operations.description: Read every theme_mod value for the active theme (secret-looking values masked), plus the effective allowlist of keys set-mods would accept

operations.name: set-mods
operations.description: Set allowlisted presentation theme_mod values (core logo/header/background mods; extend via the wpmcp_theme_mod_allowlist filter). Pass null as a value to clear that mod. Structural keys are always refused; a key with no registered validator is refused; a value that fails its validator is refused rather than coerced. Snapshotted on the theme_mods option; restorable with rollback-operation. Disabled by default (site opts in via the wpmcp_enable_theme_write filter)

operations.name: create-child-theme
operations.description: Scaffold a child theme (style.css + functions.php enqueueing the parent stylesheet) of the active theme, or of an explicit installed parent. Idempotent: re-running against an existing wpmcp-scaffolded child completes or reports it instead of failing. Refuses to build a child of a child (no grandchildren). Requires confirm:true, the edit_themes capability, file editing to be allowed on the site, and the wpmcp_enable_theme_write opt-in. Snapshotted before any file is written; rollback-operation removes the scaffold again (unless it has since been activated). Does not activate the child theme

slug.description: Directory slug for the child theme; defaults to {parent}-child. Sanitized to a safe key, confined to the themes directory

name.description: Human-readable theme Name header; defaults to "{Parent Name} Child"

parent.description: Stylesheet directory of an installed parent theme; defaults to the active theme's template. Must not itself be a child theme

operations.name: get-site-identity
operations.description: Read the site identity and homepage settings: name, tagline, home and site URL, language, timezone, logo (custom_logo theme mod) and icon (site_icon) with their attachment ids and URLs, show_on_front with the front page and posts page, and the permalink structure

operations.name: get-permalink-structure
operations.description: Read the permalink structure, category and tag bases, whether pretty permalinks are on, an example URL, the Permalinks screen presets each with its example URL and which one is current, the registered structure tags and the rewrite rule count

operations.name: test-url
operations.description: Resolve a path or URL on this site the way WordPress routes a request: the rewrite rule it matches, the query it maps to, the resulting query vars, and the post or page it reaches (post_id 0 when none). Reports when no rule matches

operations.name: set-site-logo
operations.description: Set the site logo (the custom_logo theme mod) to an image attachment, or pass null to remove it. Refuses a missing or non-image attachment and a value already in place. Snapshotted on the theme_mods option; undo: rollback-operation. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_core_site_write filter)

operations.name: set-site-icon
operations.description: Set the site icon (favicon, the site_icon option) to an image attachment of at least 512 by 512 pixels, or pass null to remove it. Refuses a missing, non-image or too small attachment and a value already in place. Snapshotted; undo: rollback-operation. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_core_site_write filter)

operations.name: set-front-page
operations.description: Show a published page as the static front page (sets show_on_front to page and page_on_front), or pass null to show the latest posts again. Refuses a missing, unpublished or non-page post, the current posts page, and a value already in place. Both options are one undo point; undo: rollback-operation. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_core_site_write filter)

operations.name: set-posts-page
operations.description: Make a published page the posts page (page_for_posts), or pass null to clear it. Refuses a missing, unpublished or non-page post, the current front page, and a value already in place; notes when show_on_front still shows posts. Snapshotted; undo: rollback-operation. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_core_site_write filter)

operations.name: set-permalink-structure
operations.description: Change the permalink structure (empty for plain, otherwise a structure with at least one %tag%, e.g. /%postname%/) and optionally the category_base and tag_base, then flush the rewrite rules (soft; hard:true also rewrites .htaccess or web.config like the Permalinks screen). Existing inbound links break, so it needs confirm:true and the preview shows the before and after example URL. The structure and both bases are one undo point (rollback-operation), which also rebuilds the rules (soft). Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_core_site_write filter)

operations.name: flush-rewrite-rules
operations.description: Rebuild the rewrite rules from the current permalink structure and registered post types and taxonomies (soft; hard:true also rewrites .htaccess or web.config). Run it with hard:true after undoing a set-permalink-structure that used hard:true. Not snapshotted: rebuilding the rules destroys nothing. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_core_site_write filter)

operations.name: list-synced-patterns
operations.description: List synced patterns (reusable blocks): id, title, status, sync state, modified. sync: synced (default), unsynced or all

operations.name: get-synced-pattern
operations.description: Read one pattern: title, sync state, block content, content_hash (for expected_hash) and how many posts place it

operations.name: find-pattern-usage
operations.description: Find the posts, templates and patterns that place a synced pattern (those you can read), with the placements in each. total is every placing post, readable the ones listed, widget_placements the block widgets that place it; truncated:true means the scan stopped at 500 candidates and total is a lower bound

operations.name: create-synced-pattern
operations.description: Create a pattern (synced unless synced:false) from block markup. Status publish or draft (default publish). Undo: rollback-session trashes it. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_core_patterns_write filter)

operations.name: update-synced-pattern
operations.description: Change a pattern's title, content or sync state; only args given change. Every post that places a synced pattern shows the new content, so check find-pattern-usage first. Pass expected_hash from get-synced-pattern to refuse a stale write. Undo: rollback-operation. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_core_patterns_write filter)

operations.name: detach-pattern-instance
operations.description: Replace every placement of a synced pattern in the posts named in post_ids (at most 50; only those posts are snapshotted and changed) with the pattern's own blocks, so later pattern edits no longer reach them. all:true takes every placing post instead and refuses over 50 or when the scan is truncated. Block attributes beyond ref (overrides, bindings) are dropped. Each post is snapshotted under one session_id; rollback-session undoes the call, and a failure part way undoes the earlier posts. Posts without a placement are skipped. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_core_patterns_write filter)

operations.name: get-hardening-status
operations.description: Hardening settings WP MCP can apply (disable XML-RPC, hide the WordPress version, block user enumeration, hide PHP errors, disable the file editor, security headers): each one's state, whether wp-config.php, the server or another plugin already handles it, and the scan-security finding it answers

operations.name: set-hardening
operations.description: Switch hardening settings on or off: settings is an object of disable_xmlrpc (also pingbacks; breaks Jetpack and the mobile apps), hide_wp_version, block_user_enumeration (visitors only), hide_php_errors, disable_file_editor, security_headers => true or false. Applied by WP MCP's hooks, no file edits. Refuses a setting something else already handles. One snapshot; undo: rollback-operation. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_hardening_write filter)

operations.name: list-font-families
operations.description: List installed Font Library families: id, name, slug, CSS font-family, face count, and active (in the global styles custom fontFamilies)

operations.name: get-font-family
operations.description: Read one installed font family by id or slug, with each face: weight, style, src, and whether its file is stored on this site

operations.name: install-google-font
operations.description: Install a family from core's Google Fonts collection by slug or name, downloading its faces to this site (all, or those in faces; a face without style matches any style). Adds missing faces to an installed family with that slug. Does not activate it in global styles. Undo: rollback-operation deletes the posts and files it made. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_font_library_write filter)

operations.name: install-font-from-upload
operations.description: Install one font face (woff2, woff, ttf or otf, up to 10 MB) from content_base64 with filename, or from an https url, under font_family (created when no family has its slug). Undo: rollback-operation deletes the posts and files it made. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_font_library_write filter)

operations.name: delete-font-family
operations.description: Delete an installed font family with its faces and their files. Needs confirm:true. Every face and its files are backed up first; undo: rollback-session. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_font_library_write filter)

operations.name: get-updraftplus-status
operations.description: UpdraftPlus status: last backup (time, success, components), files and database schedule with next run, and storage destination ids. No credentials

operations.name: list-updraftplus-backups
operations.description: List UpdraftPlus backup sets, newest first: id (timestamp), date, components with sizes, storage ids. No file names or links

operations.name: run-updraftplus-backup
operations.description: Queue an UpdraftPlus backup now (files and database). Local only unless include_remote:true. Retention may prune older sets. Not reversible. Needs confirm:true; disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_backup_plugin_run filter)

operations.name: get-duplicator-status
operations.description: Duplicator status: backup packages newest first (id, name, status, created, flags; limit, default 10) and the last completed build

operations.name: list-aio-wp-migration-backups
operations.description: List All-in-One WP Migration backups (.wpress), newest first: name, date, size. No paths or links

operations.name: list-backwpup-backups
operations.description: List BackWPup jobs (id, name, types, destinations, schedule, last run) and their backup archives, newest first: name, job, destination, size, date. No paths, links or settings

operations.name: run-backwpup-backup
operations.description: Start a BackWPup job now (job_id from list-backwpup-backups). It writes to every destination the job has, remote ones included, and retention may delete older archives. Not reversible. Needs confirm:true; disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_backup_plugin_run filter)

operations.name: get-solid-security-status
operations.description: Solid Security status: enabled modules, last site scan (time, result, findings) and counts of known vulnerabilities, active lockouts and bans. No keys or IPs

operations.name: get-sucuri-status
operations.description: Sucuri Security status: firewall and API connected, last integrity check, last malware scan (time, malware and blocklist counts), failed login count, two factor mode, XML-RPC blocked. No keys, IPs or URLs

operations.name: get-aios-status
operations.description: All In One WP Security status: protections on or off (lockout, brute force, firewall, XML-RPC, IP lists, file scan), last file change scan, counts of active lockouts, permanent blocks and failed logins. No IPs, user names or secrets

operations.name: get-limit-login-attempts-status
operations.description: Limit Login Attempts Reloaded status: local or cloud mode, lockout policy, counts of active lockouts, IPs with recent failures, total lockouts and allow and deny list entries. No IPs or user names

operations.name: get-monsterinsights-status
operations.description: MonsterInsights status: Google Analytics connection (mode, measurement id, view name) and tracking settings. No tokens

operations.name: get-wordfence-status
operations.description: Wordfence status: open scan issues by severity, last scan, firewall mode, brute force settings, application password block, install and license state. No keys

operations.name: list-wordfence-scan-issues
operations.description: Wordfence scan issues: id, type, severity, status, message and file

operations.name: list-wordfence-blocked-attacks
operations.description: Recent requests Wordfence blocked, newest first; emails inside the URL and description MASKED, the IP stays so block-wordfence-ip can use it

operations.name: list-wordfence-blocks
operations.description: Active Wordfence IP blocks: id, ip (in full, for unblock-wordfence-ip), type, reason (emails MASKED), expiration

operations.name: list-wordfence-login-failures
operations.description: Recent failed logins Wordfence recorded, newest first; the username tried is MASKED, the IP stays so block-wordfence-ip can use it

operations.name: block-wordfence-ip
operations.description: Block an IP in Wordfence (permanent unless duration, in seconds). Snapshotted; restorable with rollback-operation

operations.name: unblock-wordfence-ip
operations.description: Remove every Wordfence block on an IP. Snapshotted; restorable with rollback-operation

operations.name: ignore-wordfence-scan-issue
operations.description: Ignore a Wordfence scan issue (ignoreP: always, ignoreC: until it changes). Snapshotted; restorable with rollback-operation

operations.name: get-w3tc-status
operations.description: W3 Total Cache status: each cache (page, database, object, minify, browser, CDN, Varnish) enabled and its engine, and whether purge is available

operations.name: purge-w3tc-cache
operations.description: Purge every W3 Total Cache cache (its purge-all). A cache operation: not snapshotted, not reversible

operations.name: get-query-monitor-page-profile
operations.description: Query Monitor profile of one page of this site, loaded as a logged-out visitor: page time and memory, query count and time, slowest queries with caller, duplicate and failed queries, outgoing HTTP calls, PHP errors, busiest hooks. post_id, a path or a URL on this site (default the home page); limit (default 10, max 50). SQL literals and URL query values MASKED

operations.name: get-wp-mail-smtp-config
operations.description: WP Mail SMTP: active mailer, from identity, constant overrides and the mailer settings with credentials masked; all_mailers:true adds the other configured mailers

operations.name: get-wp-mail-smtp-log
operations.description: WP Mail SMTP Pro email log: the last N sends (subject, recipients, status, error); logging_enabled:false without Pro or with the log off

operations.name: send-wp-mail-smtp-test
operations.description: Report how mail is sent now; with recipient (your own or the admin address) and confirm:true, send a test email. Same rules as get-site-health mail_test

operations.name: set-wp-mail-smtp-from
operations.description: Set the from name and/or address WP Mail SMTP sends with. Snapshotted on the wp_mail_smtp option; restorable with rollback-operation

operations.name: get-fluent-smtp-config
operations.description: FluentSMTP: connections (provider, sender, host, port, where credentials live, last health check), additional sender routing, misc settings and defined constants; credentials are never returned, only which are set

operations.name: get-fluent-smtp-log
operations.description: FluentSMTP email log: the last N sends (status, masked recipients, subject, time, error); never the body. Optional status filter

operations.name: send-fluent-smtp-test
operations.description: Send a test email through FluentSMTP to your own or the admin address (confirm:true). Not reversible: a mail is sent (recoverable:false). Same recipient rule and hourly limit as get-site-health mail_test. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_smtp_write filter).

operations.name: set-fluent-smtp-from
operations.description: Set the sender name of the FluentSMTP connection that owns from_email (FluentSMTP routes by From address, so the address itself is not changed; an address no connection owns is refused). Saved through FluentSMTP's own settings writer; snapshotted on the fluentmail-settings option, restorable with rollback-operation. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_smtp_write filter).

operations.name: get-post-smtp-config
operations.description: Post SMTP: transport, from identity, host, port, security, run mode, logging, fallback and whether OAuth is connected; credentials are never returned, only which are set

operations.name: get-post-smtp-log
operations.description: Post SMTP email log: the last N sends (status, masked recipients, subject, transport, time, error); never the body or session transcript. Optional status filter

operations.name: send-post-smtp-test
operations.description: Send a test email through Post SMTP to your own or the admin address (confirm:true). Not reversible: a mail is sent (recoverable:false). Same recipient rule and hourly limit as get-site-health mail_test. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_smtp_write filter).

operations.name: set-post-smtp-from
operations.description: Set the from address and/or name Post SMTP sends with. Only those two settings change, never credentials or the transport. Snapshotted on the postman_options option; restorable with rollback-operation. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_smtp_write filter).

operations.name: get-image-optimizer-status
operations.description: Image optimization plugin status (Smush, ShortPixel, EWWW Image Optimizer, Imagify): compression level, auto-optimize on upload, backups, WebP and AVIF generation, library images optimized and pending, whether an API key is set, and the locally cached quota. plugin narrows it to one

operations.name: optimize-attachment
operations.description: Optimize one media library image through the active image optimization plugin (Smush, ShortPixel, EWWW Image Optimizer or Imagify; name plugin when several are active). ShortPixel and Imagify queue it on their servers (status queued). The attachment, its meta and its files are snapshotted first; undo: rollback-operation restores the original files and deletes new WebP or AVIF copies. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_image_optimizer_write filter)

operations.name: get-relevanssi-settings
operations.description: Relevanssi search and indexing settings: operator, fuzzy matching, weights, indexed post types, excerpts, highlighting, logging

operations.name: get-relevanssi-index-status
operations.description: Relevanssi index status: built or not, document and term counts, indexed post types, logging on or off

operations.name: list-relevanssi-top-searches
operations.description: Relevanssi top searches from its search log, aggregated per query (count, most results, last time), personal data masked; zero_hits:true for searches that found nothing

operations.name: rebuild-relevanssi-index
operations.description: Rebuild the Relevanssi search index with its own indexer (empties and rebuilds it; slow on large sites). Derived data: not snapshotted, not reversible

operations.name: update-relevanssi-settings
operations.description: Change Relevanssi settings (settings: {name: value}, names as get-relevanssi-settings reports them). Snapshotted as one undo point; rollback-operation restores them. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_search_write filter)

operations.name: get-fibosearch-settings
operations.description: FiboSearch (WooCommerce AJAX search) settings: search form, layout, autocomplete, analytics, as its settings screen saves them

operations.name: list-fibosearch-top-searches
operations.description: FiboSearch top searched phrases from its analytics, aggregated per phrase (count, most results, last time), personal data masked; zero_hits:true for searches that found nothing

operations.name: update-fibosearch-settings
operations.description: Change FiboSearch settings the site already has (settings: {name: text}, names as get-fibosearch-settings reports them). Snapshotted on dgwt_wcas_settings; rollback-operation restores it. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_search_write filter)

operations.name: get-site-gate-status
operations.description: Whether the public site is gated and by what: WP MCP maintenance mode, WordPress core .maintenance, and the SeedProd, WP Maintenance Mode, Under Construction, Maintenance and CMP plugins. Per gate: active, mode (coming soon or maintenance), the HTTP status and message visitors get, and who bypasses it (roles, counts, whether a bypass link or password is set; the secrets themselves are never returned). public_site_gated comes from a live request to the home page as an anonymous visitor, with the evidence in basis and probe

operations.name: enable-site-gate
operations.description: Close the public site with SeedProd (coming_soon or maintenance mode) or Under Construction. Refuses when another gate is already active, when the plugin would also lock out you (your role is not bypassed) and for SeedProd without its page set up. Needs confirm:true; the preview says what visitors will get and who bypasses it. After the write it probes wp-login.php and the REST root and restores the settings itself if either answers 503. Snapshotted; undo: rollback-operation. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_site_gate_write filter)

operations.name: disable-site-gate
operations.description: Open the public site again by turning off the SeedProd or Under Construction gate (auto picks the one that is active). Refuses when none is active. Snapshotted; undo: rollback-operation. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_site_gate_write filter)

operations.name: get-consent-banner-status
operations.description: Cookie consent plugins (Complianz, CookieYes, Cookie Notice): per plugin, installed, active, version, whether a banner shows, who manages it (the plugin or its web app), its banners, cookie count and last scan

operations.name: get-consent-settings
operations.description: One consent plugin's consent settings (credentials masked) and its banner texts with the keys update-consent-banner-texts takes. banner_id and language pick a Complianz or CookieYes banner

operations.name: list-consent-cookies
operations.description: Cookies the consent plugin's scan found (Complianz, CookieYes): name, category or service, domain, retention, purpose

operations.name: update-consent-banner-texts
operations.description: Change consent banner texts: texts maps keys (get-consent-settings lists them per plugin) to new text. Shows each text before and after. Snapshotted; undo: rollback-operation. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_consent_write filter)

operations.name: start-consent-cookie-scan
operations.description: Restart the Complianz cookie scan (it clears the scan progress and scans again in the background while an administrator has wp-admin open). Not snapshotted. Needs confirm:true. CookieYes scans in its web app. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_consent_write filter)

operations.name: list-redirection-groups
operations.description: List the Redirection plugin's groups (id, name, module, enabled, redirect count)

operations.name: list-redirection-redirects
operations.description: List Redirection plugin redirects (source, target, action type and code, match type, group, enabled, hits). Filter by group_id, status or a search over source, target and title; paged

operations.name: get-redirection-redirect
operations.description: Read one Redirection plugin redirect by id

operations.name: create-redirection-redirect
operations.description: Create a Redirection plugin redirect from a site-relative source path to a target path or http(s) URL (action_type url, codes 301/302/303/307/308, default 301), or to an HTTP error (action_type error, e.g. 410). group_id defaults to the first WordPress-module group. Loops, duplicate sources and unsafe targets are refused. Snapshotted; rollback-operation removes it

operations.name: update-redirection-redirect
operations.description: Change a Redirection plugin redirect's source, target, action_type, action_code, title or group_id; only the fields passed change. Plain URL redirects only. Loops, duplicate sources and unsafe targets are refused. Snapshotted and reversible

operations.name: enable-redirection-redirect
operations.description: Enable a Redirection plugin redirect; refused if it would close a redirect loop. Snapshotted and reversible

operations.name: disable-redirection-redirect
operations.description: Disable a Redirection plugin redirect, keeping it and its hit count. Snapshotted and reversible

operations.name: delete-redirection-redirect
operations.description: Delete a Redirection plugin redirect. The whole row is snapshotted, so rollback-operation brings it back at its own id; disable keeps it instead

operations.name: rankmath-list-redirections
operations.description: List Rank Math redirections (sources with comparison, target, header code, status, hits). Filter by status or a search over source and target; paged

operations.name: rankmath-get-redirection
operations.description: Read one Rank Math redirection by id, with its hits and last access

operations.name: rankmath-list-404-log
operations.description: List the Rank Math 404 monitor log, most requested first (uri, times accessed, last access, referer host, truncated user agent), each flagged already_redirected when an active exact redirection covers it. Needs the 404 Monitor module

operations.name: rankmath-create-redirection
operations.description: Create a Rank Math redirection from a source path to a target path or http(s) URL (comparison exact, contains, start, end or regex, default exact; header_code 301, 302, 307, 308, or 410 and 451 with no target; default 301). Loops and a source Rank Math already redirects are refused. Snapshotted; rollback-operation removes it. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_seo_redirect_write filter)

operations.name: rankmath-update-redirection
operations.description: Change a single-source Rank Math redirection: source, comparison, target, header_code or status (active or inactive, which enables or disables it). Only passed fields change. Snapshotted and reversible. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_seo_redirect_write filter)

operations.name: rankmath-delete-redirection
operations.description: Delete a Rank Math redirection. The whole row is snapshotted, so rollback-operation brings it back at its own id; set status inactive to keep it instead. Disabled by default (wpmcp_enable_seo_redirect_write filter)
